newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks surge on foreign buying, seen up.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks surge on foreign buying, seen up.

text.p: Pakistani stocks surged on Wednesday amid a strong demand for select blue chips from foreign funds, and dealers said the market might rise further on Thursday.
"It appears that the inflow of mega investment is on," a dealer at KAB Securities said, adding the index could rise further as the market was at very attractive levels.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 35.70 points, or 2.56 percent, to end at 1,432.92. Gainers led losers 157 to 52. Turnover fell to 28.55 million shares from 29.45 million on Tuesday.
